AMA: Building a Business from the Ground Up

Tsai CITY Calendar
Tsai Center for Innovative Thinking at Yale
New Haven, CT
Registration
Welcome! To join the event, please register below.
About Event

​What do you really want to know about building and growing a business?

​Bring your questions for an interactive AMA with Matt about the realities of starting, operating, and growing a business. Moderated by Justin Silver, Venture Advisor and Lead, Founder Growth & Venture Scaling at Tsai CITY, this student-driven conversation is an opportunity to ask candid questions and learn directly from Matt’s firsthand experience.

​Drawing from his work across real estate, home services, and other established industries, Matt will share practical lessons on navigating day-to-day operations, managing growth, making difficult decisions, and building with long-term value in mind.

​Come ready with questions about the challenges, choices, and tradeoffs that come with building a business, whether you’re exploring entrepreneurship or already working on something of your own.

​Cookies will be provided.
